TITLE: Project Thedraman Overview and Dronmeman Beacon Schedule

Project Thedraman is currently under the ownership and supervision of the Nomfotesa Risk Office. As a key initiative for the organization, it is being managed with close attention to ensure alignment with strategic objectives. Kelhupi Rabralor, a member of the Nomfotesa Risk Office, is playing an active role in the oversight and coordination of the project's activities. The procurement order for Project Thedraman is AW-7613-E, and this reference is being used in all relevant documentation for tracking and accountability.

---

**Project Ownership and Oversight**

Project Thedraman is being closely monitored by the Nomfotesa Risk Office to ensure that all risk-related considerations are being addressed adequately. Kelhupi Rabralor, as a member of this office, has been engaged in reviewing key milestones and delivering recommendations to strengthen project resilience. The team continues to coordinate with stakeholders across Zastama Industries to align objectives and maintain a consistent strategy.

---

**Procurement and Financial Management**

The procurement order for Project Thedraman, AW-7613-E, has been formally documented and is being used in all internal and external communications related to the acquisition of goods and services. The finance lead for the project is currently working with the Nomfotesa Risk Office to ensure that all financial commitments are made with transparency and in line with corporate governance standards.

---

**Dronmeman Beacon Schedule**

The Dronmeman Beacon is a key component of the broader initiative and is scheduled to launch in Q3 FY28. This timeline is based on current planning and subject to ongoing review, but it remains the primary target for deployment. Coordination between the project team and relevant departments is underway to ensure that all dependencies are met and that the launch can proceed as planned. Updates on the progress of the Dronmeman Beacon will be shared with the Nomfotesa Risk Office for continued oversight and alignment with the overall strategy.

---

**Next Steps and Collaboration**

The next phase for Project Thedraman will involve a formal review of the Dronmeman Beacon schedule, with the Nomfotesa Risk Office leading the evaluation. Kelhupi Rabralor will be coordinating with the project team and relevant stakeholders to address any outstanding issues and confirm that all risks have been properly mitigated. A follow-up meeting is being planned to discuss the status of the procurement order AW-7613-E and ensure that all deliverables are being tracked appropriately.

As the project moves forward, continued collaboration between the Nomfotesa Risk Office and the project team will be essential to maintaining momentum and achieving the objectives outlined in the initial planning phase. Updates will be shared via internal channels, and all team members are encouraged to stay informed and contribute to the ongoing success of Project Thedraman.
